cues: Rigid, named-section structure: 'Classification and constraints', 'Key decisions (resolved up front)', 'First end-to-end slice (Phase 0)', 'Exceptions', 'Deferred', with a 'Step 4 read-only rule' reference to a numbered external procedure
Every budget and threshold is tagged REQUIREMENT / ASSUMPTION / UNKNOWN / BASELINE, with the owner who must supply each UNKNOWN
Reversibility ratings (R2/R3) on each decision, plus 'Revisit trigger' and 'Validated by' columns
Validation checks V0–V7 each have hypothesis, method, acceptance threshold, evidence, what it unlocks and what happens on failure, and are tied to phases
A dependency table using a fixed taxonomy of seven kinds ('All seven kinds appear'), plus a per-phase cross-cutting matrix and a nine-sublayer AI layer table
